clusters.name: Walter's move to Sorrel Valley, 1952–1953
clusters.reason: Around Walter moving the family across the country to the orchard in March 1952, within the year: June became homesick and wrote to her sister daily, Walter spent long hours away from her in the trees, Glen fought at school and was sent home twice, Walter cut off from his brother Harlan over their father's land money, June kept to her bed for weeks that winter, Walter and June rowed over money for new trees, and by September June joined the church choir and her letters thinned out. The shifts in the household and between Walter and Glen, and Walter's cutoff from his brother, mark a family in turmoil over the move and the orchard.

clusters.name: Walter's orchard failing, 1968–1969
clusters.reason: Around the orchard failing in May 1968 when the late frost took the crop and the bank called in the loan, within the year: Walter drank heavily most nights, he and Glen blamed each other, Glen took over the family's money and talks with the bank, Carl's asthma attacks worsened that winter, Nora began wetting the bed again by April 1969, Ida had heart trouble found and was told to stop work, and Walter stopped drinking by October and took work pruning other men's trees. The shifts spread across the household as the family lost the orchard.

clusters.name: Glen's job lost at the cannery, 1975–1976
clusters.reason: Around Glen losing his job when the Ridgeport cannery closed in February 1975, within the year: Glen sat out of work most of that year in the truck for hours, he and Marian fought loudly at night over money, Marian took a second job cleaning offices at night, Nora stopped eating properly and lost weight that summer, Nora kept to her room and distanced from her mother, Walter drank again after six years off it by December, and by June 1976 Nora was eating again and made the track team. The shifts moved through the household as Glen's loss of work destabilized the family.

clusters.name: Wilma moving into Nora and Sam's house, 1990–1991
clusters.reason: Around Wilma moving into Nora and Sam's house in January 1990, within the year: Nora clashed with Wilma over the children's bedtimes and meals, Sam worked late and kept out of the kitchen rows, Sam took his mother's side, Owen had tantrums at preschool and was sent home twice, Wilma took over Lily's care, Nora's eczema flared on both hands, Nora and Sam rowed most nights, and by June 1991 when Wilma took a flat in town Nora's eczema cleared over the summer. The household shifted as Wilma arrived and then left.

clusters.name: Tess's drinking, 1996–1997
clusters.reason: Around Tess drinking most nights starting in October 1996, within the year: Nora phoned Tess every night, worried for her, Tess and Rick had shouting matches with Rick sleeping at his brother's for a month by March 1997, and Tess stopped drinking by June 1997 and went to meetings twice a week. The shifts centre on Tess's trouble and Nora's response.
